def saisie():
    b=False
    while(b==False):
        x=int(input('un entier:  '))
        b=x>=0
    return x
def polydivisible(x):
    p=2
    s1=''
    print('x=',x)
    s=str(x)
    print('s=',s)
    b=True
    while (b and s1!=s):
      
        s1=s[:p]
        print('s1=',s1)
        y=int(s1)
        b=y % p==0
        print('p=',p)
        print('b=',b)
        p=p+1
    return b
def affiche(b):
    if b:
        print('polydivisible')
    else:
        print('non polydivisible')
x=saisie()
b=polydivisible(x)
affiche(b)
